questions.question: Barun is the son of Chetan. Advita and Chetan are a married couple, Prakul is the brother of Chetan. Diya is the daughter of Advita. Suman is the brother of Barun. How is Diya related to Barun?
questions.solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e20f8e463dec121ef2127ecd0e3d8451f6c05cbd529fd1b01640f5ba2298ffef.png] 

(1) Barun is the son of Chetan.

(2) Advita and Chetan are a married couple, Prakul is the brother of Chetan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddf5122e23cf9987277198fc8734751f1b2f6c6fc557e173378fa3703201405a.png] 

(3) Diya is the daughter of Advita.

(4) Suman is the brother of Barun. Thus, the final family tree is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c2e9b183f9f6db1335cdf6d6a2b1e82db59ddf17dba3b78d257566f00040082.png] 

Hence, Diya is the **sister **of Barun.

questions.question: B and D are cousin brothers. A is the father of B and the uncle of C, who is the sister of D. C’s mother is married to E, who is the brother of A. How is B related to C’s father?
questions.solution:
B and D are cousin brothers. A is the father of B and the uncle of C, who is the sister of D. C’s

mother is married to E, who is the brother of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8f4ee4534eea80969d7fb51913847c35b53b29bd5fe2bd7b9a9cbeea087636a.png] 

1) B and D are cousin brothers. 

2) A is the father of B and the uncle of **C, who **is the sister of D.

Here who is used for C not B it means A is the father of B and C is the sister of D.

3) C’s mother is married to **E, who **is the brother of A.

Here C's mother is married to E and E is the brother of A.

Family tree,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50da23121e4d98723e9e5bef4dcc7daa5f4279d3684cf545c7d6336f456b167d.png] 

B is the nephew of C’s father.

Hence, **"Nephew"** is the correct answer.
